title: Build React useCounter hook — 3 turns
description: Three turns build a useCounter React hook: turn 1 increment/decrement, turn 2 reset/setValue, turn 3 step option.

task_spec.prompt: Implement `increment` and `decrement` in `src/useCounter.ts`. increment should call `setCount(c => c + step)` and decrement should call `setCount(c => c - step)`. Run `npm test -- --forceExit`.
followup_prompts: Good. Now implement `reset` (set count back to initialValue) and `setValue` (set to any provided value). Run `npm test -- --forceExit` and fix any failures.
Final check: run `npm test -- --forceExit` one more time. All 7 tests must pass. Make sure the `custom step` test works — increment/decrement should use the step from options.
success_criteria: setValue sets count to exact value
Custom step option works for both increment and decrement
